heading: Engineering that holds up beyond the first release.

children.text: I'm a Lead Software Engineer at a Fortune 300 company, with more than a decade of experience working on production systems. I enjoy turning incomplete requests into software that fits the people, processes, and constraints around it.

My day-to-day work spans implementation, maintenance, internal tooling, and the conversations that keep delivery moving. I value clear decisions, readable code, and enough context for the next engineer to understand why a system works the way it does.
